function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieves the current version of the application along with its name in a simple JSON object format. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_get_project_by_name_and_version
function.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project based on its unique name and version identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name identifier for the project. It is case-sensitive and follows the naming conventions of the system.

version.description: The version identifier of the project, typically adhering to semantic versioning. For example, '1.0.0', '1.0.1-alpha', etc.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_update_project
function.description: Updates the specified project with new information such as its name, status, or description. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to be updated.

name.description: The new name of the project.

status.description: The new status of the project.

description.description: A brief description of the project and the updates being made.

project_data.description: A collection of data representing the updates to apply to the project.

function.name: repository_api_RepositoryApi_update_repository
function.description: Updates the specified repository with new information such as name, description, and visibility settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

repository_id.description: The unique identifier of the repository to be updated.

name.description: The new name of the repository.

description.description: A short text describing the repository.

visibility.description: The visibility level of the repository.

update_fields.description: A collection of fields that need to be updated with their new values.

function.name: create_vulnerability
function.description: This function creates a new record in the system to track a vulnerability identified in a software component. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name describing the vulnerability.

severity.description: The level of severity of the vulnerability.

description.description: A detailed description of the vulnerability.

affected_component.description: The software component that is affected by this vulnerability.

discovered_date.description: The date on which the vulnerability was discovered, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

remediation_status.description: The current status of the remediation efforts.
